versos.hebraico: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָאָשָׁ֑ם קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃

controles.web: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering. It is most holy.
controles.kjv: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
controles.livre: Assim esta é a lei da expiação da culpa: é coisa muito santa.

versos.hebraico: בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁחֲטוּ֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה יִשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־הָאָשָׁ֑ם וְאֶת־דָּמ֛וֹ יִזְרֹ֥ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.
controles.kjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
controles.livre: No lugar onde degolarem o holocausto, degolarão o sacrifício pela culpa; e espargirá seu sangue em derredor sobre o altar:

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֣יב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֵ֚ת הָֽאַלְיָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃

controles.web: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,
controles.kjv: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
controles.livre: E dela oferecerá toda a sua gordura, a cauda, e a gordura que cobre os intestinos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;
controles.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
controles.livre: E os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, e o que está sobre os lombos; e com os rins tirará o redenho de sobre o fígado.

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹתָ֤ם הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה אָשָׁ֖ם הֽוּא׃

controles.web: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a trespass offering.
controles.livre: E o sacerdote o fará arder sobre o altar; oferta acesa ao SENHOR: é expiação da culpa.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכְלֶ֑נּוּ בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
controles.kjv: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
controles.livre: Todo homem dentre os sacerdotes a comerá: será comida no lugar santo: é coisa muito santa.

versos.hebraico: כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּֽאָשָׁ֔ם תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לָהֶ֑ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־בּ֖וֹ ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
controles.kjv: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
controles.livre: Como a expiação pelo pecado, assim é a expiação da culpa: uma mesma lei terão: será do sacerdote que haverá feito a reconciliação com ela.

versos.hebraico: וְהַ֨כֹּהֵ֔ן הַמַּקְרִ֖יב אֶת־עֹ֣לַת אִ֑ישׁ ע֤וֹר הָֽעֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְרִ֔יב לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
controles.kjv: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
controles.livre: E o sacerdote que oferecer holocausto de alguém, o couro do holocausto que oferecer, será para ele.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־מִנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּֽאָפֶה֙ בַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְכָל־נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בַמַּרְחֶ֖שֶׁת וְעַֽל־מַחֲבַ֑ת לַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַמַּקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ ל֥וֹ תִֽהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the pan, and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
controles.kjv: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
controles.livre: Também toda oferta de cereais que se cozer em forno, e tudo o que for preparado em panela, ou em frigideira, será do sacerdote que o oferecer.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־מִנְחָ֥ה בְלוּלָֽה־בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וַחֲרֵבָ֑ה לְכָל־בְּנֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ כְּאָחִֽיו׃פ

controles.web: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
controles.kjv: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
controles.livre: E toda oferta de cereais amassada com azeite, e seca, será de todos os filhos de Arão, tanto ao um como ao outro.

versos.hebraico: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֖יב לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E esta é a lei do sacrifício pacífico, que se oferecerá ao SENHOR:

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ם עַל־תּוֹדָה֮ יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ֒ וְהִקְרִ֣יב׀ עַל־זֶ֣בַח הַתּוֹדָ֗ה חַלּ֤וֹת מַצּוֹת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וְסֹ֣לֶת מֻרְבֶּ֔כֶת חַלֹּ֖ת בְּלוּלֹ֥ת בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.
controles.kjv: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
controles.livre: Se se oferecer em ação de graças, oferecerá por sacrifício de ação de graças tortas sem levedura amassadas com azeite, e massas sem levedura untadas com azeite, e flor de farinha frita em tortas amassadas com azeite.

versos.hebraico: עַל־חַלֹּת֙ לֶ֣חֶם חָמֵ֔ץ יַקְרִ֖יב קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ עַל־זֶ֖בַח תּוֹדַ֥ת שְׁלָמָֽיו׃

controles.web: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving.
controles.kjv: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
controles.livre: Com tortas de pão levedado oferecerá sua oferta no sacrifício de ação de graças de suas pazes.

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִמֶּ֤נּוּ אֶחָד֙ מִכָּל־קָרְבָּ֔ן תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַזֹּרֵ֛ק אֶת־דַּ֥ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
controles.kjv: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the Lord, and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
controles.livre: E de toda a oferta apresentará uma parte para oferta elevada ao SENHOR, e será do sacerdote que espargir o sangue das ofertas pacíficas.

versos.hebraico: וּבְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תּוֹדַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔יו בְּי֥וֹם קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא־יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃

controles.web: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
controles.kjv: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
controles.livre: E a carne do sacrifício de suas ofertas pacíficas em ação de graças, se comerá no dia que for oferecida: não deixarão dela nada para outro dia.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־נֶ֣דֶר׀ א֣וֹ נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ בְּי֛וֹם הַקְרִיב֥וֹ אֶת־זִבְח֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל׃

controles.web: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice; and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten:
controles.kjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
controles.livre: Mas se o sacrifício de sua oferta for voto, ou voluntário, no dia que oferecer seu sacrifício será comido; e o que dele restar, será comido no dia seguinte:

versos.hebraico: וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר מִבְּשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑בַח בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃

controles.web: but what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
controles.kjv: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
controles.livre: E o que restar para o terceiro dia da carne do sacrifício, será queimado no fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜יו בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַמַּקְרִ֣יב אֹת֗וֹ לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב ל֖וֹ פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהַנֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֲוֺנָ֥הּ תִּשָּֽׂא׃

controles.web: If any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.
controles.kjv: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
controles.livre: E se se comer da carne do sacrifício de suas pazes no terceiro dia, o que o oferecer não será aceito, nem lhe será imputado; abominação será, e a pessoa que dele comer levará seu pecado.

versos.hebraico: וְהַבָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֤ע בְּכָל־טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְהַ֨בָּשָׂ֔ר כָּל־טָה֖וֹר יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: “‘The flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the flesh, everyone who is clean may eat it;
controles.kjv: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
controles.livre: E a carne que tocar a alguma coisa impura, não se comerá; ao fogo será queimada; mas qualquer limpo comerá desta carne.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִזֶּ֤בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: but the soul who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
controles.kjv: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
controles.livre: E a pessoa que comer a carne do sacrifício pacífico, o qual é do SENHOR, estando impura, aquela pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: וְנֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תִגַּ֣ע בְּכָל־טָמֵ֗א בְּטֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ א֣וֹ׀ בִּבְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּכָל־שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְאָכַ֛ל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃פ

controles.web: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
controles.kjv: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the Lord, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
controles.livre: Além disso, a pessoa que tocar alguma coisa impura, em impureza de homem, ou em animal impuro, ou em qualquer abominação impura, e comer a carne do sacrifício pacífico, o qual é do SENHOR, aquela pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Falou ainda o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּל־חֵ֜לֶב שׁ֥וֹר וְכֶ֛שֶׂב וָעֵ֖ז לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Nenhuma gordura de boi, nem de cordeiro, nem de cabra, comereis.

versos.hebraico: וְחֵ֤לֶב נְבֵלָה֙ וְחֵ֣לֶב טְרֵפָ֔ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לְכָל־מְלָאכָ֑ה וְאָכֹ֖ל לֹ֥א תֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃

controles.web: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.
controles.kjv: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
controles.livre: A gordura de animal morto naturalmente, e a gordura do que foi arrebatado de feras, se preparará para qualquer outro uso, mas não o comereis.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י כָּל־אֹכֵ֣ל חֵ֔לֶב מִן־הַ֨בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֥יב מִמֶּ֛נָּה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֖לֶת מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: For whoever eats the fat of the animal, of which men offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
controles.kjv: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
controles.livre: Porque qualquer um que comer gordura de animal, do qual se oferece ao SENHOR oferta acesa, a pessoa que o comer, será cortada de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־דָּם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֔וּ בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לָע֖וֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
controles.kjv: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
controles.livre: Além disso, nenhum sangue comereis em todas as vossas habitações, tanto de aves como de animais.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל כָּל־דָּ֑ם וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃פ

controles.web: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
controles.kjv: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
controles.livre: Qualquer um pessoa que comer algum sangue, a tal pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמָיו֙ לַיהוָ֔ה יָבִ֧יא אֶת־קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה מִזֶּ֥בַח שְׁלָמָֽיו׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the Lord shall bring his oblation unto the Lord of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: O que oferecer sacrifício de suas pazes ao SENHOR, trará sua oferta do sacrifício de suas pazes ao SENHOR;

versos.hebraico: יָדָ֣יו תְּבִיאֶ֔ינָה אֵ֖ת אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־הַחֵ֤לֶב עַל־הֶֽחָזֶה֙ יְבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֣ת הֶחָזֶ֗ה לְהָנִ֥יף אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.
controles.livre: Suas mãos trarão as ofertas que se hão de queimar ao SENHOR: trará a gordura com o peito: o peito para que este seja movido, como sacrifício movido diante do SENHOR;

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְטִ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְהָיָה֙ הֶֽחָזֶ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
controles.livre: E a gordura a fará arder o sacerdote no altar, mas o peito será de Arão e de seus filhos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֔ין תִּתְּנ֥וּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
controles.kjv: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
controles.livre: E dareis ao sacerdote para ser elevada em oferta, a coxa direita dos sacrifícios de vossas pazes.

versos.hebraico: הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־דַּ֧ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב מִבְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן ל֧וֹ תִהְיֶ֛ה שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְמָנָֽה׃

controles.web: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
controles.kjv: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
controles.livre: O que dos filhos de Arão oferecer o sangue das ofertas pacíficas, e a gordura, dele será em porção a coxa direita;

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ אֶת־חֲזֵ֨ה הַתְּנוּפָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֑ם וָאֶתֵּ֣ן אֹ֠תָם לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ לְחָק־עוֹלָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”
controles.kjv: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Porque tomei dos filhos de Israel, dos sacrifícios de suas ofertas pacíficas, o peito que é movido, e a coxa elevada em oferta, e o dei a Arão o sacerdote e a seus filhos, por estatuto perpétuo dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את מִשְׁחַ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וּמִשְׁחַ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִקְרִ֣יב אֹתָ֔ם לְכַהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: This is the anointing portion of Aaron, and the anointing portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;
controles.kjv: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the Lord in the priest’s office;
controles.livre: Esta é pela unção de Arão e a unção de seus filhos, a parte deles nas ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, desde o dia que ele os apresentou para serem sacerdotes do SENHOR:

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ מָשְׁח֣וֹ אֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.
controles.kjv: Which the Lord commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
controles.livre: O qual mandou o SENHOR que lhes dessem, desde o dia que ele os ungiu dentre os filhos de Israel, por estatuto perpétuo em suas gerações.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את הַתּוֹרָ֗ה לָֽעֹלָה֙ לַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְלַֽחַטָּ֖את וְלָאָשָׁ֑ם וְלַ֨מִּלּוּאִ֔ים וּלְזֶ֖בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃

controles.web: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meal offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace offerings;
controles.kjv: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
controles.livre: Esta é a lei do holocausto, da oferta, da expiação pelo pecado, e da culpa, e das consagrações, e do sacrifício pacífico:

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר סִינָ֑י בְּי֨וֹם צַוֺּת֜וֹ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְהַקְרִ֧יב אֶת־קָרְבְּנֵיהֶ֛ם לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃פ

controles.web: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.kjv: Which the Lord commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.livre: A qual intimou o SENHOR a Moisés, no monte Sinai, no dia que mandou aos filhos de Israel que oferecessem suas ofertas ao SENHOR no deserto de Sinai.
